responsibility: Implements low-level REAL representation queries and manipulations using scalar floating-point builtins such as ilogb, modf, scalbn, signbit, and nextafter, along with dtoa/strtod-based decimal formatting/parsing to realize truncation and rounding by significant places. It also maintains the current mode set and raises a module-specific bad-parameter exception for invalid rounding/truncation requests.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for LowReal: it provides the REAL-specific builtins-based runtime behavior using ilogb, modf, scalbn, and nextafter and maintains the module exception source, whereas LowReal.def only declares the API and constants.
